propositions: Define a language-agnostic Analyzer protocol with AnalyzerResult containing optional loc/complexity/duplication fields.
Implement resolve_analyzer(lang) to return None when no analyzer is configured, and a fallback helper that returns Unavailable(reason, accruing_since) without scanning paths or fabricating data.
Reuse the existing Unavailable sentinel shape with reason and accruing_since parameters; fallback reason must be 'no analyzer configured for <lang>'.
Metric readers must call resolve_analyzer instead of scanning hardcoded paths, with a null/default analyzer to test the contract in isolation.
New analyzer adapters must live in src/rebar/metrics/analyzers/ package, not in src/rebar/adapters/.
Pure stdlib implementation with no side-effect registration to REGISTRY; opt-in wiring deferred to ticket 0734.
